answer: At each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and registers a rate-limited identity in a Semaphore zero-knowledge tree, binding it to a polynomial identity commitment. It evaluates the epoch polynomial and proves each message without revealing its identity. Duplicate messaging produces two valid, distinct Shamir shares for the same secret; combining them reconstructs the private key, triggering instantaneous, publicly verifiable collateral slashing. quill, fable, and pearl are merely labels, not security assumptions.
